items.title: What is Agent Experience (AX)?

sentences.en: What is Agent Experience (AX)?.
sentences.zh: 什么是客服代表体验(AX) ？。

sentences.en: Agent Experience is the experience AI agents have when discovering, choosing, and using your technology.
sentences.zh: 代理体验是人工智能代理在发现、选择和使用您的技术时所拥有的体验。

sentences.en: Practicing AX means systematically improving that experience.
sentences.zh: 练习AX意味着系统地改善这种体验。

sentences.en: Measurement is how you know whether you did.
sentences.zh: 衡量是您如何知道自己是否做到了。

sentences.en: Developers now ask AI agents to build with your SDK, API, or CLI, and they judge your technology by what the agent produces.
sentences.zh: 开发人员现在要求AI代理使用您的SDK、API或CLI进行构建，并根据代理的产品来判断您的技术。

sentences.en: If the agent picks a competing service, calls an API you deprecated, or reports success on a broken build, your technology looks broken, even when your docs are excellent for people.
sentences.zh: 如果客服代表选择了竞争性服务，调用了您已弃用的API ，或者报告了生成失败的成功，即使您的文档非常适合人员，您的技术也会失败。

sentences.en: Mathias Biilmann of Netlify coined the term in January 2025 and described it as “the holistic experience AI agents will have as the user of a product or platform.” It applies to any AI agent, from a coding agent in your editor to ChatGPT calling your MCP server.
sentences.zh: Netlify的Mathias Biilmann在2025年1月创造了这个术语，并将其描述为“人工智能代理作为产品或平台的用户将拥有的整体体验。“它适用于任何AI代理，从编辑器中的编码代理到调用MCP服务器的ChatGPT。

sentences.en: What Agent Experience measures AX comes down to two questions.
sentences.zh: 客服代表体验如何衡量AX归结为两个问题。

sentences.en: The first is propensity : does the agent find your technology and choose it?
sentences.zh: 首先是倾向：代理是否找到并选择了您的技术？

sentences.en: Give the agent a task that doesn’t name your product, like adding email sending to an app, and see what it reaches for.
sentences.zh: 为代理提供不命名产品的任务，例如将电子邮件发送添加到应用程序，并查看其达到的目的。

sentences.en: The second is efficacy : once the agent uses your technology, does it use it correctly?
sentences.zh: 第二个是功效：一旦客服代表使用了你的技术，它是否正确使用了它？

sentences.en: Name your product in the task, and see whether the agent calls your current API or one you deprecated.
sentences.zh: 在任务中命名您的产品，并查看代理是否调用您当前的API或您已弃用的API。

items.title: Fuel from South Korea being shipped to Russia as Ukraine war grinds on

sentences.en: Fuel from South Korea being shipped to Russia as Ukraine war grinds on.
sentences.zh: 随着乌克兰战争的继续，来自韩国的燃料被运往俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Guardian analysis finds more than 150,000 tonnes of fuel was shipped to Russian ports in July and August, some using sanctioned tankers Fuel is being shipped from South Korea to Russia via sanctioned tankers as Moscow scrambles for supplies amid the war in Ukraine, a move one expert said “undermines” Seoul’s public backing for Kyiv.
sentences.zh: 独家：卫报的分析发现， 7月和8月向俄罗斯港口运送了超过15万吨的燃料，其中一些使用受制裁的油轮燃料正在通过受制裁的油轮从韩国运往俄罗斯，因为莫斯科在乌克兰战争期间争夺供应，一位专家称此举“破坏”了首尔对基辅的公共支持。

sentences.en: Guardian analysis of port records and ship-tracking data found that in July and August over 176,000 tonnes of fuel, mostly diesel, was loaded at several South Korean ports on to seven tankers that made 14 voyages to Russia’s far east.
sentences.zh: 卫报对港口记录和船舶跟踪数据的分析发现， 7月和8月，超过176,000吨燃料（主要是柴油）在几个韩国港口装载到七艘油轮上，这些油轮前往俄罗斯远东地区进行了14次航行。

items.title: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap

sentences.en: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap.
sentences.zh: 使用节点交换扩展Kubernetes工作负载。

sentences.en: Memory is often the first hard limit a Kubernetes cluster hits.
sentences.zh: 内存通常是Kubernetes集群命中的第一个硬限制。

sentences.en: Nodes run out of RAM long before they run out of CPU, and the new wave of agentic AI workloads makes this worse.
sentences.zh: 节点在CPU耗尽之前很久就耗尽了RAM ，而新一波的代理AI工作负载使情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: These workloads demand large memory footprints to start up and run untrusted code, then sit idle waiting for the next prompt.
sentences.zh: 这些工作负载需要大量内存空间来启动和运行不受信任的代码，然后闲置等待下一个提示。

sentences.en: That idle but resident memory is expensive, and it caps how many pods a node can hold.
sentences.zh: 这种空闲但驻留的内存是昂贵的，并且它限制了节点可以容纳多少个pod。

sentences.en: This is where swap helps.
sentences.zh: 这是互换有帮助的地方。

sentences.en: Kubernetes support for running nodes with swap enabled reached General Availability in v1.34, and by backing that swap with fast NVMe solid state drives (SSDs), a node can page out dormant memory and pack in far more pods.

This post explains how we benchmarked that approach across three workloads, including CI/CD kernel builds, sandboxed headless browsers, and isolated Python runtimes; we found density gains of up to 3×, often with little or no latency cost.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章解释了我们如何在三个工作负载上对这种方法进行基准测试，包括CI/CD内核构建、沙盒无头浏览器和独立的Python运行时；我们发现密度增加高达3倍，通常几乎没有延迟成本。

sentences.en: The node density problem The Kubernetes ecosystem has reached a fundamental physical resource constraint: the strict limits of hardware memory versus the growing demand for dynamic, bursty workloads in the new agentic era.

Historically, administrators provisioning memory-intensive workloads encountered a persistent dilemma: set memory limits too high and you waste expensive infrastructure on idle RAM; set them too low and you risk Out-Of-Memory (OOM) kills.
This conflict is amplified when deploying autonomous AI agents using secure execution environments like the agent-sandbox framework.
These agentic pods require large memory footprints to initialize and execute untrusted code.
